title: M2A Broadcast Request Envelope
description: Typed broadcast request contract for the MCP-to-All selective fabric. One request can be routed to many responders; middleware ranks and bundles responses.

request_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this broadcast request (UUIDv4)

request_type.description: Semantic type of the broadcast — drives which responders are eligible

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the broadcast was issued

node_id.description: Unique node identifier of the issuing agent or service

pillar.description: Pillar scope — restricts broadcast to nodes within this pillar. Use 'all' for cross-pillar.

target_filter.description: Optional routing constraints applied by the middleware relevance router

required_capabilities.description: Responder must declare ALL of these capabilities to be eligible

required_domains.description: Responder must match at least one domain

pillar_scope.description: Pillar-scoped broadcast — only nodes in this pillar receive the broadcast

max_responders.description: Maximum number of responders allowed to reply. Middleware suppresses excess.

latency_class.description: Required response latency class — filters out slow responders for realtime requests

payload.description: Request-type-specific payload. Schema varies by request_type.

forecast_horizon_minutes.description: How far ahead to forecast (minutes). Used with request_forecast.

emergency_level.description: Emergency severity. Used with emergency_broadcast only.

context.description: Arbitrary structured context payload passed through to responders

sla.description: Service level agreement for this broadcast

timeout_ms.description: Maximum ms to wait for responses before middleware closes the bundle

min_responses.description: Minimum responses required before bundle is considered valid
